note: Combat now mitigates damage in two stages, like a real defense: a blow first rolls against the defender\u2019s defense, then against their armor — and a fully stopped blow shows BLOCKED instead of dealing damage. Tough monsters shrug off more of a weak hit, and a well-geared hero shrugs off more of a monster\u2019s — your armor now genuinely protects you. Arrows also lose accuracy with distance: shots are surest up close and in the middle band where archers hold their ground, and a long shot may miss outright and show MISS. Elemental weaknesses and resistances are in the data too — fire stings slimes and trolls harder than before, and gear that resists fire, ice, or lightning now genuinely blunts those blows.
